register_custom_backend: register a custom backendFunctions subclass with a name and optional device to the global customized_backend registry
create_collective_args: create a collectiveArgsHolder instance to hold parameters for a collective operation experiment including tensors ranks and backend info
calculate_bus_bandwidth: calculate bus bandwidth from algorithmic bandwidth for collectives like all_reduce all_gather reduce and broadcast using getBusBW
allocate_tensor_ones: allocate a tensor filled with ones of a given size dtype and device optionally scaled by a factor using alloc_ones
implement_backend_functions: implement a backendFunctions subclass providing abstract methods for all_reduce all_to_all broadcast barrier gemm and memory allocation
